description: Beentry connects your beekeeping records to ChatGPT. Ask about your apiaries, hives, inspections, queens, tasks, honey harvests, finances and nearby-disease alerts in plain language — and log new inspections, tasks or harvests just by chatting. Every change is confirmed before it happens, deletions are reversible, and the assistant only ever sees data from your own signed-in Beentry account.

defaultPrompt: How many hives do I have and where?
Log an inspection for Hive 1: queen seen, colony strong.
How much honey did I harvest this year and what's my balance?
